title: Project
description: One solution the agent team works on. Says where its repos and docs live, which platforms it uses (and so which skill packs), which roles are enabled, and who approves.

root.description: Folder holding the project's repos: absolute, ~, $VARS, or relative to the framework root. Available as ${project.root}.

docs_root.description: Folder with the project's own documentation, indexed for retrieval. Available as ${project.docs_root}.

handoffs_dir.description: Where handoff documents are stored, one YAML file per document named <id>.yaml. Should be inside a git repo so every handoff is versioned. Available as ${project.handoffs_dir}.

repos.description: Git repos in the project, by name. A task's repo sets ${task.repo_root}.

platforms.description: Platforms the project uses, keyed by platform name (the value tasks put in task.platform).

pack.description: Skill pack id for build work.

deploy_pack.description: Skill pack id DevOps uses for this platform. Omit if deployment stays manual (e.g. App Store).

variables.description: Values for the packs' scope=project variables.

roles.description: Roles enabled for this project, with optional per-project overrides.

model_id.description: Override the role's model for this project.

approvers.description: GitHub handles allowed to approve gates and merge PRs.
